source.title: DSIR: assessing the design of highly potent siRNA by testing a set of cancer-relevant target genes
source.license: CC BY; version not specified in the source article

endpoint.name: residual_expression
endpoint.measurement: percent residual non-cleaved target mRNA relative to control

assay_conditions.selection_design: two rounds; second-round candidates were selected using first-round findings

selection_and_limits: The source describes DSIR-designed, high-score-selected guides; score range and design selection limit generalization.
The article prose says 128 sequences; the matched S1/S3 tables contain 129 unique guide rows.
The article analyzes features on this same panel; subsequent siRNAforge feature associations are exploratory.
No broad measured unintended-repression endpoint is included.
Zero sequence overlap with tracked source extracts and OligoGym files does not establish non-overlap with every external training corpus.
Asymmetry is evaluated on the validated 19-nt paired core as an applicability-limited proxy; the source duplex has two-base 3-prime overhangs unlike the shipped fully complementary 21-nt geometry.
